name: Faded Photo
descriptionTemplate: The caused {Weakness} effect +5%. When applying {Weakness}, temporarily {Steal} [Arg1] {STR} from the target.
lore: The blurry photo carries a blurry Memory, or perhaps—it's the incompleteness of Memory that leads to the photo's fading.
